product.name: Aurelio Harmony 4-String Ukulele
product.description: The Aurelio Harmony 4-String Ukulele offers a lightweight, resonant option for both beginners and traveling musicians. Constructed with a durable acrylic body and nylon strings, it delivers bright, clear tones while remaining easy to handle. The instrument measures 45 cm in length and weighs 0.4 kg, making it comfortable for extended practice sessions. Its compact design fits easily into standard instrument cases, and the Sun‑set Red finish adds a touch of style. The Harmony is ready to play straight out of the box, requiring no tuning or setup beyond standard string tension adjustments.
